title: Dropped Stitch Troubleshooter
description:
Dropped stitches happen to every knitter - but they don’t have to derail your project. <br><br>This interactive Troubleshooter walks you through a short diagnostic to understand why it’s happening and what you can do about it. <br>You’ll choose the option that best matches what you’re seeing, and the guide will give you: <ul>

<li>the most likely cause </li>

<li>a simple, practical fix</li>

<li> one action step you can take right away </li>
</ul>

Clear, calm, and to the point — so you can get back to knitting with confidence.
